verdict.rationale: Runway's pricing page lists an "Agentic creative collaborator" as a product feature, which suggests a built-in agent users can hand creative work to. That is the only first-party mention, and nothing describes what tasks it accepts or how it carries them out. The Runway MCP lets external agents like Claude and ChatGPT drive Runway, and Characters are an API building block, so neither is a built-in assistant; Runway Ads is a separate automated feature. Missing for 10: any documentation of the assistant's capabilities, examples of multi-step task delegation inside the app, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
